in_marathi.name: Eshan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of the Sun
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Eshan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ashtau' which means 'eight' and 'Sah' meaning 'lord'. The name Eshan is the name of the Sun God and is believed to bring prosperity, good fortune, and success to the bearer of this name.

in_bengali.name: Eshan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of the Sun
in_bengali.long_meaning: Eshan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। The name Eshan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ashtau' which means 'eight' and 'Sah' meaning 'lord'. The name Eshan is the name of the Sun God and is believed to bring prosperity, good fortune, and success to the bearer of this name.
